name: Conic Finance
fix_description: Protect handleDepeggedCurvePool against read-only reentrancy. Check that the Curve pool is not in the middle of a state-changing operation (e.g. verify pool reentrancy lock status) before reading its price. Alternatively, use a cached/TWAP price that cannot be manipulated by mid-transaction state inconsistency.
difficulty_reasoning: This PoC uses a sophisticated multi-stage attack chain with nested Aave v2/v3 and Balancer flash loans, repeated pool state manipulation, and three separate read-only reentrancy entry points across Curve/Conic interactions. Exploiting it requires deep understanding of Conic’s depeg handling, oracle pricing during liquidity removal callbacks, and cross-protocol state timing, which is well beyond a straightforward auditor write-up.
